subcategory_text: Networks and network services are monitored to find potentially adverse events
informative_references: CSF v1.1: DE.CM-1, DE.CM-4, DE.CM-5, DE.CM-7
CRI Profile v2.0: DE.CM-01, DE.CM-01.01, DE.CM-01.02, DE.CM-01.03, DE.CM-01.04, DE.CM-01.05, DE.CM-01.06
implementation_examples: Monitor DNS, BGP, and other network services for adverse events
Monitor wired and wireless networks for connections from unauthorized endpoints
Monitor facilities for unauthorized or rogue wireless networks
Compare actual network flows against baselines to detect deviations
Monitor network communications to identify changes in security postures for zero trust purposes
assessment_objectives: Determine whether networks and network services are monitored to find potentially adverse events.
Determine whether activities are conducted to monitor DNS, BGP, and other network services for adverse events.
Determine whether activities are conducted to monitor wired and wireless networks for connections from unauthorized endpoints.
Determine whether implementation outcomes are monitored, evaluated, and documented.
